cases.source_text: A various carbazole derivatives were synthesized for the synthesis 2,3-Dihydro-1H-carbazol-4(9H)-one O-acety oxime (3), ethyl 2-(2,3,4,9-tetrahydrospiro[carbazole-1,2′-[1,3]dithiolane]-2-yl)acetate (5), 2- hydroxyethyl {2,3,4,9-tetrahydrospiro[1H-carbazole-1,2′[1,3]dithiolane-4-one]-2-yl}-acetamide (7). These products (3, 5, and 7) were characterized by the spectroscopic techniques (IR, <sup>1</sup>H NMR, <sup>13</sup>C NMR and elemental analysis). Then, the observed FT-IR and NMR peaks of the studied compounds were compared with the calculated values. The FMO analyses disclosed that the (5) would prefer intermolecular interactions more than intramolecular in- teractions because ofits higher energy gap. NBO analyses displayed that the n → П* and П→ П* interactions were responsible for the lowering ofthe stabilization energy. The molecular docking studies showed that (5) exhibited highest binding affinity with the human glutathione reductase at binding site (−7.21 kcal/mol). Also, the antiox idant activities were investigated using the CUPRAC method, and TEAC coefficient implied that compound (3) have an antioxidant property, In addition, docking calculations of the compound (3). (5), and (7) were performed on bacterial tyrosinase enzyme and human glutathione reductase protein.

cases.translated_text: 咔唑衍生物和四环氮杂辛并 $[4,3-b]$ 吲哚骨架构成了马钱子碱的结构，它们是代表性的三环和四环化合物。这些化合物拥有广泛的已知生物活性物质范围以及多种药理活性，如抗氧化活性、抗HIV活性和阿尔茨海默病治疗活性 $^{[1-7]}$。此外，由于哌嗪及其杂化化合物的生物特性使其在医学领域（尤其是抗菌、抗过敏和抗氧化方面）更为重要，因此实验和计算研究均广泛涉及此类化合物 $^{[8,9]}$。在此背景下，近期的一项研究揭示了电子结构与 有机体系的生化性质之间的关系，并通过分子对接支持其结果 $^{[10]}$。此外，鉴于苯乙胺杂化化合物的药用价值，利用光谱和物理化学方法并结合量子化学方法对其进行了详细研究 $^{[11]}$。

cases.source_text: It is well known that the nature of X-H bonds in molecular systems have very strong anharmonic couplings and therefore generally give broadband in IR spectra [47]. Furthermore, the possible intermolecular Hydrogen bonding formation between an X-H bond in a molecule and the external Y functional group causes the X-H bond to be elongated, thus enhanced the IR density, and redshift of the related X-H vibration [48,49]. In a recent work, the O–H valance vibration of a new hybrid complex monomer was observed [50] in 3583 cm<sup>−1</sup> and predicted by DFT method in 3611 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } . In addition, the νN-H mode was recorded [51] in 3439 cm<sup>−1</sup> and assigned in 3455 cm<sup>−1</sup> (99% PED). In this work, all compounds (3, 5, and 7) include one secondary amine func- tional group which give an N–H bond stretching vibration in 3417, 3406, and \bar { 3 3 5 8 } ~ \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } , and assigned by PED analysis in 3611, 3621, and 3622 cm<sup>−1</sup>. Furthermore, the (7) included one –O–H group and therefore the νO-H mode of (7) was assigned in 3801 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } (100% PED) with a high IR intensity.
cases.translated_text: 众所周知，分子体系中 X–H 键的性质具有非常强的非谐耦合，因此通常在红外光谱中产生 宽带吸收 $^{[47]}$。此外，分子中 X–H 键与外部 Y 官能团之间可能形成的分子间氢键会导致 X–H 键伸长，从而增强红外强度，并使相关 X–H 振动发生红移 $^{[48,49]}$。在最近的一项工作中，观察到一种新型杂化配合物单体的 O–H 价振动位于 $3583\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$，并通过 DFT 方法预测为 $3611\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$。另外，记录到 νN-H 模式位于 $3439\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$，并指认为 $3455\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$（99% PED）。在本工作中，所有化合物（**3**、**5** 和 **7**）均包含一个仲胺官能团，其 N–H 键伸缩振动分别出现在 $3417$、 $3406$ 和 $3358\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$，并通过 PED 分析指认为 $3611$、 $3621$ 和 $3622\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$。此外，化合物（**7**）包含一个 –O–H 基团，因此（**7**）的 νO-H 模式被指认为 $3801\ \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$（100% PED），具有较高的红外强度。

cases.source_text: Systemic arterial hypertension, the leading cause of global disease burden and overall health loss, affects over two-fifths of the adult population worldwide $ ^{[1-4]} $. Given the progressive ageing of the world population and considering the rapidly growing prevalence of uncontrolled hypertension, the evolution of cognitive impairment is increasingly becoming a prominent health threat. The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that about two-thirds of the cerebrovascular disease is attributable to elevated blood pressure $ ^{[5]} $. Furthermore, accruing epidemiological and mechanistic evidence suggests that hypertension is a risk factor for the onset and progression of cognitive impairment, vascular dementia and Alzheimer's disease $ ^{[6-63]} $. In view of its pivotal role in cognitive impairment particularly of vascular origin, the WHO has set a global target to relatively reduce 25% of the hypertension burden by 2025 as a fundamental measure to reduce the risk of cognitive decline $ ^{[64]} $.
cases.translated_text: 系统性高血压是全球疾病负担和总体健康损失的首要原因，影响着全球超过五分之二的成年人口 $^{[1-4]}$。鉴于世界人口的老龄化以及未控制高血压患病率的迅速增长，认知障碍的演变正日益成为一项突出的健康威胁。世界卫生组织（WHO）估计，约三分之二的脑血管疾病可归因于血压升高 $^{[5]}$。此外，越来越多的流行病学和机制证据表明，高血压是认知障碍、血管性痴呆和阿尔茨海默病发生及进展的危险因素 $^{[6-63]}$。鉴于其在认知障碍尤其是血管源性认知障碍中的关键作用，WHO 设定了到 2025 年相对减少 25% 高血压负担的全球目标，作为降低认知衰退风险的基本措施 $^{[64]}$。

cases.source_text: Physical activity was assessed using the Physical Activity Vital Sign (PAVS)[82] questionnaire whereby reported moderate-vigorous physical activity of 0min/week, <150min/week, or $ \geq $ 150min/week was used to categorize participants as inactive, underactive or active respectively. We defined underweight as BMI < 18.5kg/m², normal: BMI 18.5–24.9kg/m², overweight: BMI 25.0–29.9kg/m² and obese: BMI ≥30.0kg/m²[83]. Individuals who smoked at least 1 cigarette in the past 6 months were regarded as current smokers, those who last smoked over 6 months or self-reported quitting smoking were considered ex-smokers and those who never smoked were regarded as never-smokers. Alcohol drinking was defined as at least a once consumption every week. Social activeness was assessed through participants' self-assessment (i.e. active vs inactive) regarding their participation in important social activities (i.e. weddings, burial ceremonies, and traditional festivals).
cases.translated_text: 体力活动采用体力活动生命体征（PAVS） $^{[82]}$ 问卷进行评估，其中报告的中等强度至高强度体力活动为 $0\text{min/week}$、 $<150\text{min/week}$ 或 $\geq 150\text{min/week}$，用于 将参与者分别归类为不活跃、活动不足或活跃。我们将体重过轻定义为 BMI $< 18.5\text{kg/m}^2$，正常:BMI $18.5\text{–}24.9\text{kg/m}^2$，超重:BMI $25.0\text{–}29.9\text{kg/m}^2$，肥胖:BMI $\geq 30.0\text{kg/m}^2$ $^{[83]}$。过去6个月内至少吸烟1支者被视为当前吸烟者，最后一次吸烟超过6个月或自我报告已戒烟者被视为既往吸烟者，从未吸烟者被视为从不吸烟者。饮酒定义为每周至少消费一次。社会活跃度通过参与者对其参与重要社交活动（即婚礼、葬礼和传统节日）的自我评估（即活跃与不活跃）进行评定。

cases.source_text: Hypertension was defined as SBP ≥140mmHg or DBP ≥90mmHg, and/or use of BP lowering agents[84]. Moreover, SBP ≥140mmHg or DBP ≥90mmHg was used to define uncontrolled BP. Orthostatic hypotension was defined by a decrease in SBP ≥20mmHg or DBP ≥10mmHg within 3 min of standing when compared to the sitting measurements. Diabetes was diagnosed using a glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) of ≥6.5% and/or fasting blood glucose (FBG) ≥7mmol/L or use of glucose-lowering agents[85]. A 2-dimensional echocardiography was utilized for the diagnosis heart failure. Renal functions were estimated using the Modification of Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) equation and renal dysfunction was defined by an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) value of <60mL/min/1.73m²[86]. WHO criteria for anemia i.e. hemoglobin (Hb) concentration of <13.0g/dL for males and <12.0g/dL for females was used to diagnose anemia[87]. Triglycerides and low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cut-off levels of 1.7mmol/L[88] and 3.5mmol/L[89] respectively were used to categorize hypertriglyceridemia and elevated LDL respectively. Uric acid levels of 480μmol/L and 360μmol/L were used to denote hyperuricemia among males and females respectively[90].
cases.translated_text: 高血压定义为收缩压（SBP）≥140 mmHg 或舒张压（DBP）≥90 mmHg，和/或使用降压药物 $^{[84]}$。此外，SBP ≥140 mmHg 或 DBP ≥90 mmHg 用于定义血压控制不佳。直立性低血压定义为与坐位测量值相比，站立后3 min内 SBP 下降 ≥20 mmHg 或 DBP 下降 ≥10 mmHg。糖尿病诊断依据为糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）≥6.5% 和/或空腹血糖（FBG）≥7 mmol/L 或使用降糖药物 $^{[85]}$。采用二维超声心动图诊断心力衰竭。肾功能通过肾脏病饮食改良（MDRD）公式估算，肾功能不全定义为估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）<60 mL/min/1.73 m²$^{[86]}$。贫血诊断采用世界卫生组织（WHO）标准，即男性血红蛋白（Hb）浓度 <13.0 g/dL，女性 <12.0 g/dL$^{[87]}$。甘油三酯和低密度脂蛋白（LDL）的临界值分别为1.7 mmol/L$^{[88]}$ 和3.5 mmol/L$^{[89]}$，分别用于分类高甘油三酯血症和高LDL血症。男性和女性尿酸水平分别以480 μmol/L和360 μmol/L作为高尿酸血症的界定标准 $^{[90]}$。

cases.source_text: A reciprocal interplay between education and cognitive functions has been observed across studies $ ^{[113,114]} $. Despite the lack of a formal consensus regarding the definition of low education, it is considered the most effective modifiable risk factor for cognitive impairment globally[115–117]. Recent analyses have noted that education does change the point at which accelerated declines due to cognitive impairment occur[118]. In this present study, participants with low education had over three-fold chance of having cognitive impairment and indeed it was the strongest predictor. These findings are consistent with a meta-analysis by Meng X and D'Arcy C which revealed a pooled OR of 2.61 for cognitive impairment among those with low education[119]. Educational attainment contributes to individual differences in cognitive skills hence people with higher education perform better across a broad range of cognitive tasks[120]. Moreover, current data shows that continuing education and cognitive leisure activities increase cognitive reserve thus improving cognitive functions and lower incidence of cognitive impairment[121].
cases.translated_text: 多项研究观察到教育与认知功能之间存在相互影响 $^{[113,114]}$。尽管目前对低教育程度的定义尚未形成正式共识，但其被视为 全球范围内导致认知障碍的最有效的可改变危险因素 $^{[115–117]}$。近期分析指出，教育确实会改变因认知障碍而加速衰退的起始时间点 $^{[118]}$。在本研究中，低教育程度参与者发生认知障碍的风险超过三倍，且确实是预测力最强的因素。这些发现与Meng X和D'Arcy C的一项荟萃分析一致，该分析显示低教育程度人群认知障碍的合并比值比（OR）为2.61$^{[119]}$。受教育程度有助于个体在认知技能上的差异，因此受教育程度较高的人群在广泛的认知任务中表现更好 $^{[120]}$。此外，现有数据表明，持续教育和认知休闲活动可增加认知储备，从而改善认知功能并降低认知障碍的发生率 $^{[121]}$。
